instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Strato is a management consulting firm serving mid-market companies with strategy, operational excellence, and digital transformation engagements. With 40 consultants across three offices, the firm focuses heavily on high-touch implementation and bespoke strategic advising. Current efforts are centered on evaluating knowledge management AI to capture past engagement insights for automated proposal development.
answers.pastInitiatives: A junior engineer built an internal dashboard to visualize our order backlog, which the operations team found useful. However, this was an informal side project with no official support or maintenance plan. When that engineer left, the dashboard became unreliable and was eventually abandoned. This highlights a critical gap in institutionalizing good ideas into scalable solutions.
answers.strategicGoals: Customer retention has declined from 92% to 84% over the past 18 months, primarily among our mid-tier and enterprise segments. Exit interviews consistently cite product stagnation and poor digital self-service tools as reasons for leaving. We need to urgently modernize our customer-facing technology and proactively address the specific pain points driving churn before the trend becomes irreversible.
answers.additionalContext: The firm faces intense pressure from larger competitors who are rapidly adopting SaaS-based service delivery models. Immediate, decisive action is required to differentiate our offering through technology and efficiency gains.
answers.teamSize: We have a small technology team of 4-6 people including developers, a part-time DevOps engineer, and a product manager who also handles project management. The team is fully allocated to maintaining current products and handling integration requests from key clients. Innovation work is done in the margins — there is no formally ring-fenced innovation time or budget.

opportunities.title: AI-Powered Proposal Engine MVP
opportunities.rationale: Leveraging the existing interest in knowledge management AI and short time horizon, developing a Minimum Viable Product (MVP) for automated proposal generation can immediately improve efficiency and output quality. This addresses the internal pain point of manual proposal creation which likely contributes to client dissatisfaction.

first_actions: Conduct 2-week feasibility study on existing data pipeline integration with an off-the-shelf GenAI tool.
Allocate $5,000 from the innovation budget for a pilot build focused solely on proposal summarization.
execution_plan.success_metric: 20% reduction in time spent per proposal by Q3.
milestones: Month 1: AI tool selection and data mapping complete
Month 3: Internal Alpha testing of the MVP feature set

opportunities.title: Hyper-Niche Digital Advisory SaaS Spin-off
opportunities.rationale: Given the high competitive pressure and low digital maturity, a radical pivot involves isolating our most profitable niche consulting service (e.g., operational excellence) into a low-cost, automated subscription tool. This shifts revenue from hourly billable time to scalable recurring revenue streams, offering immediate market defense against low-cost competitors.

first_actions: Identify the top 2 most profitable, repeatable consulting service for automation focus.
Engage a boutique startup partner to design and build a basic MVP subscription platform.
resources_needed: Talent transfer/recruitment focus on product management skills
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 10% recurring revenue from the new digital product line within 9 months.
milestones: Month 2: Business model validation and niche segment locking
Month 6: Successful launch of the B2B SaaS pilot with 5 paying customers

next_steps.action: Establish a formal, quarterly 'Innovation Sprint' within the small leadership team structure.
Conduct talent assessment to identify key technical roles required for digital maturity level 2.

key_weaknesses: Lack of formal innovation governance and process structure.
Critical dependency on informal talent, leading to high turnover risk in key technical roles.
Low digital maturity prevents scalable self-service offerings necessary for modern customer retention strategies.
Limited budget (15%) severely restricts the ability to fund long-term, radical R&D.
